commitResults.messageBody:
Java sources and tests contain inconsistent documentation, naming, and formatting that conflict with the project coding standard.

Standardize Javadocs and names. Give related constants common prefixes, rename the serialization helper with a verb, and align test formatting.

This keeps production and test code consistent without changing behavior.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add project Java coding standard skill
commitResults.messageBody:
Agents need a reusable source of the Java conventions that apply to this project.

Add the SE-EDU-based skill and require agents to invoke it for Java creation, editing, refactoring, and review.

This keeps future production and test code aligned with the same standard.

Luna.java: Add assertions to parser results
commitResults.messageBody:
Luna accesses parser results using fixed array indexes. A future change to
a parser's return structure could cause command handling to fail with an
unclear index error.

Assert the expected array lengths before extracting command, deadline, and
event fields. This documents the contract between Parser and Luna and makes
violations fail close to their source when assertions are enabled.

commitResults.messageTitle: Refactor: Remove unused UI output methods
commitResults.messageBody:
Ui has task-specific printing methods that are no longer called after
responses moved into Luna for reuse by both CLI and GUI clients.
Keeping those methods and commented call sites suggests a second
presentation path and duplicates user-facing response logic.

Remove the unreachable methods, their imports, and the stale
commented-out calls. Keep the active string-returning response flow
unchanged so both interfaces continue to display the same output.

commitResults.messageTitle: Refactor: Tighten task encapsulation
commitResults.messageBody:
Task state and date fields expose more mutation surface than their
behavior requires, while Luna exposes an addition helper used only by
its own command handlers. TaskList also preallocates an unexplained
capacity that provides no demonstrated benefit.

Make task descriptions and dates immutable, keep completion state
private, and serialize through existing accessors. Restrict addTask to
Luna and let TaskList use the default ArrayList capacity. These changes
make ownership explicit without changing observable behavior.

commitResults.messageTitle: Task: Reject invalid completion flags
commitResults.messageBody:
Reject values other than 0 or 1 so corrupted task data is reported instead
of being silently treated as incomplete.

commitResults.messageTitle: Refactor: Centralize task date handling
commitResults.messageBody:
Deadline and event tasks duplicate date parsing and formatting rules.
Centralize those rules to keep task date behavior consistent.
